about.heading: About
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Charles. I live in Hackensack, New Jersey, and I've been building for the web since the first version of this site, which was hand-written HTML and a Bootstrap theme. I studied information systems at NJIT in Newark and graduated in 2023.

My title at EarthCam is data analyst; the work is machine learning engineering. I train computer vision models in PyTorch, decide which ones are good enough for production, and build the pipelines, APIs and monitoring that keep them running and honest.

Since January 2026 I also build for clients on my own: secure apps on AWS and Supabase with REST APIs and React dashboards on top, scoped with the client and carried from the first sketch through deployment and support.
I like the unglamorous parts best: the dataset tooling nobody asked for, the registry that makes a training run reproducible, the cost cut that nobody notices because nothing got slower.
Most of the work is patience, then one good result.
If you have a model to train or a system to build, I would like to hear about it. And if you keep scrolling, there is something else I do with my patience.
